verdict.what: Two open items from the 'Open, for the lab' line are gone and appear nowhere on the remaining board. (2) B3: the plan's per-request CPU number is not on file, and /api/play deep slices (~103 ms) will hit error 1102 on a 10 ms plan. The fix is to cap `from` or get the number (Morphyx). (3) acts.jsonl logged nothing from 10-09 to 10-14 02:42 although writes were made, and the gap is unexplained (Modulo). The pointer that was meant to replace item (1) is also missing.
